title: SandboxOptions
description: Configuration options for initializing a Sandbox instance

backend.description: Execution backend identifier (e.g. native, docker, firecracker, wasi)

cpu.description: Number of CPU cores allocated (hard rate-cap semantics, shared with cpuQuota). Legacy name: backends honor cpuQuota when set and fall back to cpu otherwise; the two must not be applied differently. Values at or below zero mean unset; values above host capacity pass through and never bind.

cpuQuota.description: CPU core allocation quota in cores, fractional allowed (e.g. 0.5). Hard rate cap: throttles the whole process tree, never kills (RFC 0007). Takes precedence over cpu. Values at or below zero mean unset; values above host capacity pass through and never bind. Composes orthogonally with cpuTimeLimit (throttled workloads still die by budget on CPU exhaustion). Enforcement reported via cpuQuotaLimits; macOS reports false.

cpuTimeLimit.description: CPU time budget in milliseconds (e.g. 2000). Supported boundary: enforced across the full process group by the native backend. Distinct from timeout (wall-clock) and from cpuQuota (rate cap that throttles instead of killing).

diskQuota.description: Disk storage quota for the sandbox workspace (e.g. '100MB', '1GB', or bytes). Enforced on VFS writes and, during execution, across the workspace via process-group kill with ERR_DISK_QUOTA_EXCEEDED.

workDir.description: Working directory inside the sandbox workspace. Contained to the sandbox root: path traversal or absolute host paths are rejected (FS_ERROR).

env.description: Explicit environment variables injected into executions. The host environment is NOT inherited wholesale; only a documented minimal allowlist (PATH, HOME, temp/locale variables) is carried from the host. These explicit values override the allowlist.

osFilesystemIsolation.description: RFC 0006: apply OS-level filesystem isolation (workspace + runtime allowlist, else deny) when the backend supports it. Defaults to true when the mechanism is supported; false is an explicit opt-out, never a silent downgrade.

image.description: Container image identifier (only used by docker or microvm backends)
